data.exact_reserve_text: Included within claims notified of USD 1,398.0m (2021: USD 1,400.1m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of account of USD 229.9m (2021: increase in claims notified relating to 2020 and prior years of account USD 397.3m which is impacted by effect of RITC noted in the table above ).

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 into 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1686
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer of 2018 year liabilities of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 into the 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1686; noted as impacting technical provisions and the claims development profile (financial impact stated as nil).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a small net favourable prior-year reserve movement (approximately a USD 21.4m release) driven by overall favourable claims development and reinsurance actions. The claims development triangle shows net releases across older underwriting years partially offset by adverse movements in some cohorts; the year was also affected by reinsurance portfolio transactions (an RITC into the 2019 year and a loss portfolio reinsurance covering 2019 and prior) which have influenced the technical provisions presentation.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within claims notified of USD 1,398.0m (2021: USD 1,400.1m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of account of USD 229.9m (2021: increase in claims notified relating to 2020 and prior years of account USD 397.3m which is impacted by effect of RITC noted in the table above ).

Effective 1 December 2022, the Syndicate completed a loss portfolio reinsurance contract (LPR) with another Lloyd's syndicate. Under the agreement, the Syndicate has been indemnified against potential adverse development in respect of net liabilities for a premium of USD 59.7m, providing the Syndicate with protection in several professional lines insurance portfolios, predominantly relating to 2019 and prior years of account.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative incurred triangle) because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was present. An RITC (1 Jan 2021) and a Loss Portfolio Reinsurance (LPR) (1 Dec 2022) are disclosed and may distort development patterns; this reduces confidence in attributing movement solely to claims experience. All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) and converted from the report's USD '000 into millions. Confidence for the PYD figure is therefore set lower than an explicit movement note.
